en.t: Count Emicho enters Mainz, where his followers massacre Jewish citizens. At least 600 Jews are killed
en.s: Mainz (German: [maɪnts] ; see below) is the capital and largest city of the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate, and with around 223,000 inhabitants, it is Germany's 35th-largest city. It lies in the Rhine-Main Metropolitan Region — Germany's second-largest metropolitan region after Rhine-Ruhr — which also encompasses the cities of Frankfurt am Main, Wiesbaden, Darmstadt, Offenbach am Main, and Hanau.

zh.t: 埃米霍伯爵进入美因茨，随从屠杀犹太居民，至少600人遇害
zh.s: 美因茨（德语发音：[maɪnts]）是德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨州首府和最大城市，人口约223,000，是德国人口第35多的城市。美因茨位于莱茵—美因都会区，这是德国第二大都会区，仅次于莱茵—鲁尔都会区；该都会区还包括法兰克福、威斯巴登、达姆施塔特、奥芬巴赫和哈瑙。

en.t: Malcolm IV becomes King of Scotland
en.s: Malcolm IV (Medieval Gaelic: Máel Coluim mac Eanric; Scottish Gaelic: Maol Chaluim mac Eanraig), nicknamed Virgo, "the Maiden" (between 23 April and 24 May 1141 – 9 December 1165) was King of Scotland from 1153 until his death. He was the eldest son of Henry, Earl of Huntingdon and Northumbria (died 1152) and Ada de Warenne.

zh.t: 马尔科姆四世成为苏格兰国王
zh.s: 马尔科姆四世（中古盖尔语：Máel Coluim mac Eanric；苏格兰盖尔语：Maol Chaluim mac Eanraig），绰号“处女王”（拉丁语：Virgo），于1153年至1165年去世期间担任苏格兰国王。他是亨廷顿和诺森伯兰伯爵亨利（1152年去世）与阿达·德·瓦雷讷的长子。

en.s: The Battle of Ilevollene on 27 May 1180 was a battle between king Sverre Sigurdsson and king Magnus Erlingsson taking place at Ila in modern day Trondheim. The battle ended up as a huge victory for king Sverre. After the birkebeiners won the Battle of Kalvskinnet in June 1179 they stayed in Nidaros.

zh.s: 伊勒沃莱内战役发生于1180年5月27日，是国王斯韦雷·西居尔松与国王马格努斯·埃林松之间的一场战斗，地点在今特隆赫姆的伊拉。斯韦雷一方大获全胜。此前，伯克比内尔派于1179年6月在卡尔夫斯金内特战役中获胜，之后留在尼达罗斯。

en.t: John is crowned King of England
en.s: John (Christmastide 1166/7 – 19 October 1216) was King of England from 1199 until his death in 1216. He lost the Duchy of Normandy and most of his other French lands to King Philip II of France, resulting in the collapse of the Angevin Empire and contributing to the subsequent growth in power of the French Capetian dynasty during the 13th century.

zh.t: 约翰加冕为英格兰国王
zh.s: 约翰（约1166/1167年圣诞节期间—1216年10月19日）于1199年至1216年去世期间担任英格兰国王。他将诺曼底公国和大部分法国领地输给法国国王腓力二世，导致安茹帝国瓦解，并推动13世纪法国卡佩王朝势力增长。

en.t: Richard of Cornwall, and his wife, Sanchia of Provence, are crowned King and Queen of the Germans at Aachen Cathedral
en.s: Sanchia of Provence (c. 1225 – 9 November 1261) was Queen of the Romans from 1257 until her death in 1261 as the wife of King Richard. Sanchia was the third daughter of Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Provence, and Beatrice of Savoy. She was described as an "incomparable beauty". In 1243 she married Richard, then still an English prince and Earl of Cornwall.

zh.t: 康沃尔的理查与妻子普罗旺斯的桑恰在亚琛大教堂加冕为德意志国王和王后
zh.s: 普罗旺斯的桑恰（约1225年—1261年11月9日）是理查国王的妻子，1257年至1261年去世前担任罗马王后。她是普罗旺斯伯爵雷蒙·贝伦格尔四世和萨伏依的比阿特丽斯的第三个女儿，曾被称为“无与伦比的美人”。1243年，她嫁给当时仍是英格兰王子、康沃尔伯爵的理查。

en.s: The Battle of Cempoala was fought on 27 May 1520 at Cempoala, Mexico, between the forces of Pánfilo de Narváez and the forces of Hernán Cortés, which were supported by Chinantec warriors.

zh.s: 森波阿拉战役于1520年5月27日在墨西哥森波阿拉打响，交战双方是潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯与埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的部队；科尔特斯一方有钦南特克战士支援。

en.s: The Conquest of Kalmar (Swedish: Erövringen av Kalmar) took place on 27 May 1523, during the Swedish War of Liberation (1521-1523). In the beginning of 1523, Kalmar and Stockholm remained as the only real Danish strongholds in Sweden. The situation in Kalmar was tense, with many German Landsknechte mercenaries in Danish hire stationed in the city.

zh.s: 卡尔马征服战（瑞典语：Erövringen av Kalmar）发生于1523年5月27日，是瑞典解放战争（1521—1523年）的一部分。1523年初，卡尔马和斯德哥尔摩是瑞典境内仅存的丹麦主要据点。卡尔马局势紧张，城内驻有许多受丹麦雇用的德国兰茨克内希特雇佣兵。

en.s: The Battle of Clontibret was fought in County Monaghan in May 1595, during the Nine Years' War in Ireland. A column of 1,750 English troops led by Henry Bagenal was ambushed near Clontibret by a larger Gaelic Irish army led by Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone. The English column had been sent to relieve the besieged English garrison at Monaghan Castle.

zh.s: 克朗蒂布雷特战役于1595年5月在爱尔兰九年战争期间发生于莫纳亨郡。亨利·巴格纳尔率领1,750名英军纵队前往解救被围困的莫纳亨城堡英军守军，途中在克朗蒂布雷特附近遭蒂龙伯爵休·奥尼尔率领的一支规模更大的盖尔爱尔兰军队伏击。

en.s: The Battle of Shanhai Pass, fought on 27 May 1644 at Shanhaiguan (山海關) at the eastern end of the Great Wall of China, was a decisive battle leading to the formation of the Qing dynasty in China. There, Qing Prince-Regent Dorgon allied with former Ming general Wu Sangui to defeat rebel leader Li Zicheng of the Shun dynasty, allowing Dorgon and the Manchus to rapidly conquer Beijing and replace the Ming dynasty.

zh.s: 山海关之战于1644年5月27日在长城东端的山海关（山海關）打响，是促成清朝在中国建立的关键战役。清摄政王多尔衮与前明将领吴三桂结盟，击败了大顺政权的起义领袖李自成，使多尔衮和满洲军队得以迅速攻占北京并取代明朝。

en.s: The Battle of Finta (27 May 1653) was a confrontation between Prince Matei Basarab's Wallachian army and a combined Moldavian–Cossack–Tatar force under Prince Vasile Lupu and Tymofiy Khmelnytsky. It took place around Finta, now a commune in Dâmbovița County, Romania. The battle began by an attack of Moldavian infantry and Tatar–Cossack cavalrymen. From the beginning, the Moldavians, Tatars and Cossacks were driven back by the Wallachian military forces and Lithuanian defenders.

zh.s: 芬塔战役发生于1653年5月27日，交战双方是马泰·巴萨拉布亲王率领的瓦拉几亚军队，以及瓦西里·卢普亲王和季莫菲·赫梅利尼茨基率领的摩尔达维亚、哥萨克和鞑靼联军。战斗发生在今罗马尼亚登博维察县芬塔镇附近。摩尔达维亚步兵和鞑靼—哥萨克骑兵率先发起进攻，但他们从一开始就被瓦拉几亚军队和立陶宛守军击退。

en.s: An English expeditionary force captured Spanish Jamaica in May 1655, during the Anglo-Spanish War of 1654–1660. It was part of an ambitious plan by Oliver Cromwell to undermine or obliterate Spanish dominance in the Americas and to acquire new colonies there, known as the Western Design. Although major settlements like Santiago de la Vega, now Spanish Town, were poorly defended and quickly occupied, resistance by escaped slaves, or Jamaican Maroons, continued in the interior.

zh.s: 英军远征部队于1655年5月攻占西属牙买加，正值1654—1660年英西战争期间。这是奥利弗·克伦威尔宏大计划的一部分，旨在削弱或摧毁西班牙在美洲的势力并夺取新殖民地，该计划名为“西方远征”。圣地亚哥·德拉维加（今西班牙镇）等主要定居点防守薄弱，很快被英军占领；但逃奴组成的牙买加马龙人仍在内陆持续抵抗。

en.s: The Western Design was an English expedition against the Spanish West Indies during the 1654 to 1660 Anglo-Spanish War. Part of an ambitious plan by Oliver Cromwell to end Spanish dominance in the Americas, the force was short of supplies and poorly trained. Leadership was split between Robert Venables, commander of land forces, and Admiral William Penn; the relationship between the two quickly broke down, and they regarded each other with distrust and suspicion.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西方远征计划是1654—1660年英西战争期间，英国远征西属西印度群岛的行动。这是奥利弗·克伦威尔为终结西班牙在美洲的统治而制定的宏大计划的一部分。远征军补给不足、训练不佳；陆军指挥官罗伯特·韦纳布尔斯和海军上将威廉·佩恩意见不合，很快相互猜疑。

en.s: The battle of Nagyvárad in 1664 occurred when an army of Hungarians and Germans led by László Rákóczy attacked Nagyvárad in order to capture it; however, despite gaining entry, they were later repelled from the city by the Ottoman garrison.

zh.s: 1664年，拉斯洛·拉科齐率领的匈牙利和德国军队进攻纳吉瓦拉德，意图夺取该城。他们一度攻入城内，但随后被奥斯曼守军击退。

en.s: The Battle of Torroella, also known as Battle of the river Ter, was a battle in the Nine Years' War, fought on 27 May 1694 along the banks and fords of the Ter River near the Puente Mayor in the vicinity of the important town of Girona, Catalonia, Spain.

zh.s: 托罗埃利亚战役又称特尔河战役，是九年战争期间的一场战斗，于1694年5月27日在西班牙加泰罗尼亚赫罗纳附近、重要城镇赫罗纳周边的特尔河河岸和浅滩发生，靠近大桥（Puente Mayor）。

en.s: The First Battle of Karasu was a battle that occurred during the Russian–Turkish War of 1768-1774, which took place during the Russian army's campaign in Wallachia and Rumelia.

zh.s: 第一次卡拉苏战役是1768—1774年俄土战争期间的一场战斗，发生在俄军于瓦拉几亚和鲁米利亚的战役中。

en.s: The Battle of Lipniszki took place on 27 May 1794 (Old Style: 16 May) during the Polish uprising led by Tadeusz Kościuszko. The battle ended in a Russian victory under the leadership of Bennigsen, who fought in it against the divisions of Jasiński and Chlewiński.

zh.s: 利普尼斯基战役于1794年5月27日（旧历5月16日）爆发，是塔德乌什·柯斯丘什科领导的波兰起义的一部分。俄军在本尼格森指挥下获胜；与他交战的是亚辛斯基和赫列维恩斯基率领的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Oulart Hill took place on 27 May 1798 when a rebel gathering of between approximately 1,000 annihilated a detachment of 110 militia sent from Wexford town to stamp out the spreading rebellion in County Wexford.

zh.s: 奥拉特山战役发生于1798年5月27日。约1,000名起义者聚集后，歼灭了一支由110名民兵组成的分队；这支分队从韦克斯福德镇出发，试图镇压在韦克斯福德郡蔓延的叛乱。

en.s: The Pitt–Tierney Duel took place on 27 May 1798 when the prime minister of Great Britain William Pitt the Younger met his political opponent George Tierney in a duel with pistols on Putney Heath outside London.

en.s: The Battle of Winterthur (27 May 1799) was an important action between elements of the Army of the Danube and elements of the Habsburg army, commanded by Friedrich Freiherr von Hotze, during the War of the Second Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The small town of Winterthur lies 18 kilometres (11 mi) northeast of Zürich, in Switzerland. Because of its position at the junction of seven cross-roads, the army that held the town controlled access to most of Switzerland and points crossing the Rhine into southern Germany.

zh.s: 1799年温特图尔战役发生于5月27日，是多瑙河军团部分部队与哈布斯堡军队之间的一场重要交战。哈布斯堡军队由弗里德里希·弗赖赫尔·冯·霍策指挥。这场战斗发生在第二次反法同盟战争期间，属于法国大革命战争的一部分。瑞士小城温特图尔位于苏黎世东北18公里（11英里）处，坐落于七条道路的交汇点。控制这座城镇，就能掌握通往瑞士大部分地区以及跨过莱茵河进入德国南部的通道。

en.s: The Battle of Fort George was fought during the War of 1812, in which the Americans defeated a British force and captured Fort George in Upper Canada. The troops of the United States Army and vessels of the United States Navy cooperated in a very successful amphibious assault, although most of the opposing British force escaped encirclement.

zh.s: 乔治堡战役发生于1812年战争期间，美军击败英军并攻占上加拿大的乔治堡。美国陆军与海军舰艇协同实施了一次十分成功的两栖突击，但大多数英军还是逃脱了合围。

en.t: 1839 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1839 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 27 May 1839. James Abercromby had retired due to failing health. The next day he was raised to the peerage as Baron Dunfermline. Charles Shaw-Lefevre was proposed by Henry Handley and seconded by Stephen Lushington. Henry Goulburn was proposed by Sir Watkin Williams-Wynn and seconded by John Wilson-Patten. Both candidates addressed the House.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1839年5月27日举行议长选举。詹姆斯·阿伯克龙比因健康状况恶化退休，次日获封邓弗姆林男爵。查尔斯·肖-勒菲弗由亨利·汉德利提名、斯蒂芬·拉辛顿附议；亨利·高尔本由沃特金·威廉斯-温爵士提名、约翰·威尔逊-帕滕附议。两名候选人都向下议院发表了讲话。

en.s: The Convention of Canton (Mandarin Chinese: 广州和约), also known as the Canton Peace Agreement, was an unequal treaty signed on 27 May 1841 between the Qing Dynasty, represented by imperial commissioner Yishan and the United Kingdom, represented by plenipotentiary Charles Elliot. The treaty brought a temporary end to hostilities in the Canton area during the First Opium War after the conclusion of the Second Battle of Canton on 26 May 1841.

zh.s: 《广州和约》（普通话：广州和约），又称《广州和平协定》，是清朝与英国于1841年5月27日签订的一项不平等条约。清方代表为钦差大臣奕山，英方代表为全权公使查尔斯·义律。第一次鸦片战争期间，广州第二次战役于5月26日结束后，该条约暂时停止了广州地区的战事。

en.s: The Second Assault of Dellys was an assault by French troupes coloniales under General Thomas Robert Bugeaud (1784–1849) against the Algerian resistance fighters in the town of Dellys, Kabylia of the Igawawen. It was part of the French conquest of Algeria and took place in April–May 1844.

zh.s: 第二次德利斯袭击是法国殖民军在托马·罗贝尔·比若将军（1784—1849）指挥下，对卡比利亚伊加瓦温地区德利斯镇的阿尔及利亚抵抗力量发动的进攻。此战是法国征服阿尔及利亚的一部分，发生于1844年4月至5月。

en.s: The battle of Nigoiti took place between 20 and 27 May 1854 the village of Nigoiti in Guria during the Crimean War. Russo-Georgian detachments, under the command of Ivane Andronikashvili, met an invading Ottoman force that had crossed the Choloki river, the border between the Russian and Ottoman Empires.

zh.s: 尼戈伊蒂战役发生于1854年5月20日至27日，地点是克里米亚战争期间古里亚的尼戈伊蒂村。伊万·安德罗尼卡什维利率领的俄格联军与一支入侵的奥斯曼军队交战；奥军已越过俄奥帝国边界上的乔洛基河。

en.s: The Battle of Escape Creek was a naval engagement fought between the United Kingdom's Royal Navy and the Qing Chinese naval force on 25–27 May 1857 during the Second Opium War. Commodore Charles Elliot's squadron chased the war-junks at Escape Creek (present-day East River) and then, once the British ships were grounded as the river narrowed, they chased them in the ships' boats until all the junks had been overhauled.

zh.s: 逃脱溪之战是第二次鸦片战争期间的一场海战，于1857年5月25日至27日发生在英国皇家海军与清朝水师之间。查尔斯·义律准将的舰队追击逃到逃脱溪（今东江）的清军战船。河道变窄、英舰搁浅后，英军改乘小艇继续追击，最终追上了所有战船。

en.s: The Battle of Shakopee occurred on the morning of Thursday, May 27, 1858, between Murphy's Landing in Shakopee and Eden Prairie, Minnesota, on the banks of the Minnesota River. It was the last battle of the Dakota-Ojibwe War.

zh.s: 沙科皮战役发生于1858年5月27日星期四上午，地点在明尼苏达州沙科皮的墨菲登陆点与伊甸草原之间、明尼苏达河岸边。这是达科他人—奥吉布瓦人战争的最后一场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of San Fermo, which took place 27 May 1859 at a pass near Como in the northern part of Lombardy, was an engagement of the Second Italian War of Independence in which the Italian volunteers of Giuseppe Garibaldi's Hunters of the Alps defeated an Austrian force, forcing the Austrians to abandon Como.

zh.s: 圣费尔莫战役发生于1859年5月27日，地点在科莫附近的一处山口，属于第二次意大利独立战争。朱塞佩·加里波第率领的意大利志愿军击败奥地利军队，迫使奥军放弃科莫。

en.s: The siege of Palermo took place between 27 and 30 May 1860 in Palermo, Sicily, during the Expedition of the Thousand led by Giuseppe Garibaldi against the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, as part of the Italian unification wars.

en.s: The Battle of Hanover Court House, also known as the Battle of Slash Church, took place on May 27, 1862, in Hanover County, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula Campaign of the American Civil War. On May 27, elements of Brig. Gen. Fitz John Porter's V Corps extended north to protect the right flank of Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan's Union Army of the Potomac. Porter's objective was to deal with a Confederate force near Hanover Court House, which threatened the avenue of approach for Union reinforcements that were marching south from Fredericksburg.

zh.s: 汉诺威法院战役又称斯拉什教堂战役，是美国内战半岛战役的一部分，于1862年5月27日在弗吉尼亚州汉诺威县发生。当天，菲茨·约翰·波特准将率第五军团部分部队向北推进，以保护乔治·B·麦克莱伦少将率领的波托马克联邦军右翼。波特的目标是对付汉诺威法院附近的一支南军，因为这支部队威胁到从弗雷德里克斯堡南下增援联邦军的通道。

en.s: The Herat campaign of 1862–1863 was a conflict between the Principality of Herat and the Emirate of Afghanistan, from March 1862, when Sultan Ahmad Khan captured Farah from the Muhammadzai Emirs and continued through the 10-month long siege of Herat, ending on May 27, 1863, when the city fell to the Amir-i Kabir, thus completing the unification of Afghanistan.

zh.s: 1862—1863年赫拉特战役是赫拉特公国与阿富汗埃米尔国之间的冲突。1862年3月，苏丹·艾哈迈德汗从穆罕默德扎伊埃米尔手中夺取法拉，战事由此开始；随后赫拉特遭围困十个月。1863年5月27日，赫拉特城陷落，落入阿富汗埃米尔国“大埃米尔”（Amir-i Kabir）之手，阿富汗由此完成统一。

en.s: The Battle of Pickett's Mill was fought on May 27, 1864, in Paulding County, Georgia, during the American Civil War between Union and Confederate forces. Union Maj. Gen. William Tecumseh Sherman attempted an attack on the right flank of Confederate Gen. Joseph E. Johnston. After the Union defeat at New Hope Church, Sherman ordered Maj. Gen. Oliver O. Howard to attack Johnston's seemingly exposed right flank. The Confederates were ready for the attack, which did not unfold as planned because supporting troops never appeared. The Confederates repulsed the attack causing high casualties.

zh.s: 皮克特磨坊战役于1864年5月27日在佐治亚州保尔丁县打响，是美国内战期间联邦军与南军之间的一场战斗。联邦军少将威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼试图攻击南军将军约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿的右翼。联邦军在新希望教堂战败后，谢尔曼命令少将奥利弗·O·霍华德进攻约翰斯顿看似暴露的右翼。南军早有准备；由于支援部队没有到场，进攻未按计划展开。南军击退了进攻，联邦军伤亡惨重。

en.t: Alexander III is crowned Tsar of Russia
en.s: Alexander III (Russian: Александр III Александрович Романов, romanized: Aleksandr III Aleksandrovich Romanov; 10 March 1845 – 1 November 1894) was Emperor of Russia, King of Poland and Grand Duke of Finland from 13 March 1881 until his death in 1894. He was highly reactionary in domestic affairs and reversed some of the liberal reforms of his father, Alexander II, a policy of "counter-reforms" (Russian: контрреформы).

zh.t: 亚历山大三世加冕为俄罗斯沙皇
zh.s: 亚历山大三世（俄语：Александр III Александрович Романов，转写：Aleksandr III Aleksandrovich Romanov；1845年3月10日—1894年11月1日）自1881年3月13日起担任俄罗斯皇帝、波兰国王和芬兰大公，直至1894年去世。他在内政上极为保守，推翻了其父亚历山大二世的部分自由主义改革，这项政策被称为“反改革”（俄语：контрреформы）。

en.s: On May 27, 1896, a tornado caused severe damage to downtown St. Louis, Missouri, East St. Louis, Illinois, and surrounding areas. en.s: Full general elections were held in Belgium on 27 May 1900. They were the first elections under a proportional system (using the D'Hondt method) instead of a majority system. This was an innovation in Europe, as Belgium became the first country to adopt proportional representation as basis of its electoral system. To make the system possible, smaller electoral districts (arrondissements) were grouped into a single electoral district (a group of arrondissements). The introduction of proportional representation was beneficial to the Liberal Party, which significantly increased its number of seats. The Liberal Party previously suffered losses after the introduction of universal suffrage in 1894.

zh.s: 比利时于1900年5月27日举行全国大选。这是该国首次采用比例代表制（使用德洪特法），取代多数制。这项改革在欧洲开创先例，比利时成为第一个将比例代表制作为选举制度基础的国家。为实施新制度，原本较小的选区（区）被合并为一个选区组。比例代表制的引入有利于自由党，该党议席大幅增加；此前，普选权于1894年扩大后，自由党曾遭遇议席下滑。

en.s: The Battle of Tsushima (Russian: Цусимское сражение, Tsusimskoye srazheniye), also known as the Battle of Tsushima Strait and the Naval Battle of the Sea of Japan (Japanese: 日本海海戦, Nihonkai-Kaisen) in Japan, was a major naval battle fought between Russia and Japan during the Russo-Japanese War. It was naval history's only decisive sea battle fought by modern steel battleship fleets, and the first naval battle in which wireless telegraphy (radio) played a critically important role. It has been characterized as the "dying echo of the old era – for the last time in the history of naval warfare ships of the line of a beaten fleet surrendered on the high seas."

zh.s: 对马海战又称对马海峡海战；在日本也称日本海海战（日语：日本海海戦，Nihonkai-Kaisen）。这是日俄战争期间俄国与日本之间的一场重要海战。它是现代钢铁战列舰舰队之间唯一一场具有决定性结果的海战，也是无线电报发挥关键作用的第一场海战。有评论将其称为“旧时代最后的回响”：在海战史上，战败舰队的战列舰最后一次在公海投降。

en.t: HMS Princess Irene explodes and sinks off Sheerness, Kent, with the loss of 352 lives
en.s: HMS Princess Irene was a 5,394 GRT ocean liner which was built in 1914 by William Denny and Brothers Ltd, Dumbarton, Scotland for the Canadian Pacific Railway. On 27 May 1915, she exploded and sank off Sheerness, Kent, while being loaded with mines prior to a deployment mission, with the loss of 352 lives.

en.s: The Austrian presidential elections of 1951 marked the first time that the President of Austria was elected by popular vote. en.s: The Dahlerau train disaster was a railway accident that occurred on May 27, 1971, in Dahlerau, a small town in Radevormwald, West Germany, in which a freight train and a passenger train collided head-on. Forty-six people perished in the accident; forty-one were senior year pupils of the Geschwister-Scholl-Schule in Radevormwald. It was the deadliest accident in West Germany since its foundation in 1949, surpassed after German reunification by the Eschede train disaster in 1998.

zh.s: 达勒劳火车事故于1971年5月27日在西德拉德沃姆瓦尔德的一座小镇达勒劳发生。一列货运列车与一列客运列车迎头相撞，造成46人死亡，其中41人是拉德沃姆瓦尔德席勒兄妹学校的高年级学生。这是西德1949年建国以来最严重的事故；德国统一后，1998年的埃舍德火车事故死亡人数超过了这次事故。

en.s: Bagbati massacre (Bengali: বাগবাটি গণহত্যা) refers to the killings of more than 200 unarmed Bengali Hindus by the Al Badar, Pakistan Army, Razakars and Peace Committee, in the Bagbati Union of Sirajganj sub-division in the erstwhile district of greater Pabna in May 1971. After the massacre the bodies were buried or dumped in wells.

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 27 May 1972 to elect the 82 members of the Legislative Assembly of Queensland. The Country-Liberal Coalition won its sixth consecutive victory since it won government in 1957 and also its second victory under Joh Bjelke-Petersen.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1972年5月27日举行选举，选出昆士兰州立法议会82名议员。乡村党—自由党联盟取得连续第六次胜利；该联盟自1957年上台以来从未失利。这也是约翰·比耶尔克-彼得森领导下的第二次胜利。

en.s: On 27 May 1975, a coach carrying elderly passengers crashed at the bottom of a steep hill at Dibble's Bridge over the River Dibb, near Hebden in North Yorkshire, England. Thirty-three people on board were killed, including the driver, and thirteen others injured. It was the worst-ever road accident in the United Kingdom by number of fatalities.

zh.s: 1975年5月27日，一辆载有老年乘客的客车在英格兰北约克郡赫布登附近驶过迪布桥（River Dibb上的Dibble's Bridge）时，在陡坡底部发生事故。车上包括司机在内的33人死亡，另有13人受伤。按死亡人数计算，这是英国历史上最严重的道路交通事故。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 331 was an international passenger flight operated by an Ilyushin Il-62M that crashed about 1 km (0.62 mi) from José Martí International Airport, in Havana, Cuba, on 27 May 1977. The accident occurred after the aircraft hit power lines on its final approach to the airport during poor weather. The aircraft was attempting an emergency landing due to a fire in one of its engines.

zh.s: 苏联民航331号班机是一架由伊尔-62M执飞的国际客运航班，于1977年5月27日在古巴哈瓦那何塞·马蒂国际机场附近坠毁，坠地点距机场约1公里（0.62英里）。飞机在天气恶劣时最后进近，撞上电线；当时飞机的一台发动机起火，正试图紧急降落。

en.s: The Battle of Bondo was a battle fought on 27 May 1979 near the town of Bondo, in northern Uganda, between Tanzanian forces and Ugandan troops loyal to Idi Amin, during the Uganda–Tanzania War. A band of Uganda Army soldiers opened fire on the Tanzanian Minziro Brigade as it advanced towards Arua, before fleeing in the face of a Tanzanian charge.

zh.s: 邦多战役于1979年5月27日在乌干达北部邦多镇附近打响，交战双方是坦桑尼亚军队与效忠伊迪·阿明的乌干达部队。当时正值乌坦战争，一支乌干达陆军小队向正朝阿鲁阿推进的坦桑尼亚明齐罗旅开火，随后在坦军冲锋下撤退。

en.s: The 1981 European Cup final was an association football match between Real Madrid of Spain and Liverpool of England on 27 May 1981 at the Parc des Princes, Paris, France. It was the final match of the 1980–81 season of Europe's premier cup competition, the European Cup. Real Madrid were appearing in their ninth final, they had previously won the competition six times and lost twice.

zh.s: 1981年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1981年5月27日在法国巴黎王子公园球场举行，参赛双方是西班牙皇家马德里和英格兰利物浦。这是1980—81赛季欧洲顶级俱乐部杯赛的最后一场比赛。皇家马德里第九次闯入决赛，此前曾六次夺冠、两次失利。

en.s: The Beaconsfield by-election, 1982 was a parliamentary by-election held on 27 May 1982 for the British House of Commons constituency of Beaconsfield in Buckinghamshire. It is notable for being the only election Tony Blair lost in his 25-year political career. He was elected to parliament for Sedgefield, County Durham in the following year's general election, became party leader in 1994 and went on to become prime minister with three consecutive general election wins.

zh.s: 1982年比肯斯菲尔德选区补选于5月27日举行，选出英国下议院比肯斯菲尔德选区的议员。托尼·布莱尔在其25年政治生涯中唯一一次选举失利，就是这次补选。次年，他在达勒姆郡塞奇菲尔德选区的大选中当选议员；1994年成为工党领袖，随后三次带领工党赢得大选并出任首相。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt on 27 May 1984. Since the last election in 1979, changes had been made to the electoral system. The 176 two-member constituencies were replaced by 48 multi-member constituencies (totalling 448 seats), with candidates elected on a party list system, with a party needing over 8% of the vote to win a seat.

zh.s: 埃及于1984年5月27日举行议会选举。自1979年上次选举以来，选举制度有所调整：176个双席位选区改为48个多席位选区，共448席，采用政党名单制。政党须获得超过8%的选票才能赢得席位。

en.s: The 1987 European Cup final was a football match held at the Praterstadion, Vienna, Austria, on 27 May 1987, that saw FC Porto of Portugal defeat Bayern München of West Germany 2–1. Both sides were missing key players: the Germans were missing their sweeper and captain Klaus Augenthaler, who was suspended, along with striker Roland Wohlfarth and midfielder Hans Dorfner, who were both injured, while the Portuguese were without their injured striker Fernando Gomes.

zh.s: 1987年欧洲冠军杯决赛于5月27日在奥地利维也纳普拉特球场举行，葡萄牙波尔图以2比1击败西德拜仁慕尼黑。双方都有主力缺阵：拜仁的后卫兼队长克劳斯·奥根塔勒因停赛缺席，前锋罗兰·沃尔法特和中场汉斯·多夫纳则因伤缺阵；波尔图的前锋费尔南多·戈麦斯也因伤未能出场。

en.s: The 1988 Hargeisa Burao offensive (Somali: Gudo-galkii Hargeysa iyo Burco) was a major offensive conducted during the Somaliland War of Independence in May 1988 by the Somali National Movement on the cities of Hargeisa and Burao, then the second and third largest cities of Somalia. The SNM captured Burao on 27 May within two hours, while the SNM entered Hargeisa on 29 May, overrunning most of the city apart from its airport by 1 June.

zh.s: 1988年哈尔格萨—布劳攻势（索马里语：Gudo-galkii Hargeysa iyo Burco）是索马里民族运动于1988年5月发动的一次重要军事攻势，战场为哈尔格萨和布劳。当时两城分别是索马里的第二和第三大城市。索马里民族运动于5月27日用两小时攻占布劳，5月29日进入哈尔格萨；到6月1日，除机场外已控制该市大部分地区。

en.s: The Concert for Democracy in China (Chinese: 民主歌聲獻中華) was a benefit concert held in Hong Kong in support of the students involved in the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. The concert was held on May 27, 1989, at the Happy Valley Racecourse on Hong Kong Island. The event lasted for 12 hours and raised over HK$12,000,000 (1.54 million US dollars) for the students in Beijing.

zh.s: “中国民主歌声演唱会”（中文：民主歌聲獻中華）是1989年5月27日在香港岛跑马地马场举行的一场义演，旨在支持参与1989年天安门广场抗议活动的学生。演出持续12小时，为北京学生筹得超过1,200万港元（154万美元）。

en.s: General elections were held in Myanmar on 27 May 1990, the first multi-party elections since 1960, after which the country had been ruled by a military dictatorship. The elections were not meant to form a parliamentary government, but rather to form a parliament-sized constitutional committee to draft a new constitution. The elections were won convincingly by Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD), who took 392 of the 492 seats. However, the military junta refused to recognise the results, and ruled the country as the State Peace and Development Council until 2011. Voter turnout was 72.6%.

zh.s: 缅甸于1990年5月27日举行大选，这是自1960年以来首次多党选举。此后该国一直处于军政府统治之下。这次选举并非为了组建议会政府，而是选出一个规模相当于议会的制宪委员会，负责起草新宪法。昂山素季领导的全国民主联盟（NLD）以明显优势获胜，赢得492席中的392席。但军政府拒绝承认选举结果，并以国家和平与发展委员会名义继续统治，直到2011年。投票率为72.6%。

en.s: The 1991 WFA Cup Final was the 21st final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Millwall Lionesses and Doncaster Belles contested the match at the Prenton Park, the home stadium of Tranmere Rovers F.C. on 27 Mayl 1991. Millwall won the game 1–0 with a goal by Yvonne Baldeo.

en.s: Triplemanía II-C was a major lucha libre, or professional wrestling event Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) that took place at the El Toreo bullfighting arena in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico on May 27, 1994. The show was the final of three Triplemanía II shows held in 1994, preceded by Triplemanía II-A in April and Triplemanía II-B held 12 days prior. 1994 was the first year AAA held multiple Triplemanía shows in a year, a tradition they would continue through 1997, after which Triplemanía became a single annual event.

zh.s: Triplemanía II-C是墨西哥职业摔角联盟AAA在下加利福尼亚州蒂华纳斗牛场El Toreo举行的一场大型赛事，于1994年5月27日举行。这是1994年举办的三场Triplemanía II赛事中的最后一场；此前，Triplemanía II-A于4月举行，Triplemanía II-B则在12天前举行。1994年是AAA首次在一年内举办多场Triplemanía赛事，这一做法延续到1997年；此后Triplemanía改为每年举办一场。

en.s: The attack on Stolice was an attempt by the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) to control the positions of the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) on Mountain Majevica in 1994. en.s: The Battle of Vrbanja Bridge was an armed confrontation which occurred on 27 May 1995 between United Nations (UN) peacekeepers from the French Army and elements of the Bosnian Serb Army of Republika Srpska (VRS). Upon seizing the bridge, the VRS took the French peacekeepers hostage.

zh.s: 弗尔巴尼亚桥战役是1995年5月27日发生的一场武装冲突，交战双方为法国军队的联合国维和人员，以及波黑塞族共和国军（VRS）部队。波黑战争期间，VRS夺取了萨拉热窝米利亚茨卡河上弗尔巴尼亚桥两端由法国驻守的联合国保护部队（UNPROFOR）观察哨，随后发生了这场冲突。塞族部队占领桥梁后，扣押了法国维和人员。

en.s: A deadly tornado outbreak occurred in Central Texas during the afternoon and evening of May 27, 1997, in conjunction with a southwestward-moving cluster of supercell thunderstorms. These storms produced 20 tornadoes, mainly along the Interstate 35 corridor, from northeast of Waco to north of San Antonio. The strongest tornado was an F5 tornado that completely obliterated a residential subdivision along the northwestern outskirts of Jarrell, killing 27 people and injuring 12 others.

en.s: In the afternoon hours of May 27, 1997, a large, slow-moving and violent F5 tornado caused extreme damage across portions of the Jarrell, Texas area. Known most frequently as the Jarrell tornado, it killed 27 residents in the Double Creek Estates, which at the time was a small subdivision located to the northwest of Jarrell, and inflicted approximately US$40 million in damages (equivalent to $80M in 2025) during its 13-minute, 5.1-mile (8.2 km) track.

en.s: The 2007 Spanish local elections were held on Sunday, 27 May 2007, throughout all 8,111 Spain municipalities, simultaneously with regional elections in 13 of the 17 autonomous communities—all except for Andalusia, the Basque Country, Catalonia, and Galicia. All 65,869 councillors were up for election, as well as 153 seats of the 3 Basque Juntas Generales, 153 seats of the 7 Canarian cabildos and the indirectly-elected 1,038 seats of the 38 provincial deputations. The match was between Barcelona and Alavés at the Vicente Calderón in Madrid.

en.s: The 2017 Pro12 Grand Final was the final match of the 2016–17 Pro12 season. The 2016–17 season was the third with Guinness as the title sponsor and the eighth ever League Grand Final. en.s: In the afternoon of May 27, 2018, after over 8 inches (20 cm) of rain in a span of two hours, the historic Main Street in Ellicott City, Maryland experienced catastrophic flooding, just days before the new flood emergency alert system was supposed to become operational. Flooding occurred throughout the Patapsco Valley, in the adjacent communities of Catonsville, Arbutus, and Elkridge, as well as the Jones Falls Valley in Baltimore.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 27 May 2018. As no candidate received a majority of the vote, the second round of voting was held on 17 June. Incumbent president Juan Manuel Santos was ineligible to seek a third term. Iván Duque, a senator, defeated Gustavo Petro, former mayor of Bogotá, in the second round. Duque's victory made him one of the youngest individuals elected to the presidency, aged 42.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于2018年5月27日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得多数票，第二轮投票于6月17日举行。时任总统胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯不能竞选第三个任期。第二轮中，参议员伊万·杜克击败波哥大前市长古斯塔沃·佩特罗。杜克当选时年仅42岁，是当时最年轻的总统当选人之一。

en.s: An election for the leadership of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) was held on 27 May 2021 at a meeting of the Ulster Unionist Party council.
